name: API Layer
description: ASP.NET Core presentation and composition root: the thin AuthController and its /api/auth endpoints, Program.cs DI/JWT/Scalar wiring, the FluentValidation action filter, and the HTTP request scratch file.

name: Application Layer
description: Authentication use cases (AuthService), request/response DTOs, FluentValidation validators, the Result/error model, and the repository, token, hashing, email, and identity-validation interfaces that Infrastructure implements.

name: Domain Layer
description: Framework-free core model of tenants and identities: User, UserAccount, Organization, OrganizationMembership, EmailVerificationToken entities and the OrganizationRole enum.

name: Persistence Layer
description: EF Core data access for PostgreSQL: CortexDbContext and design-time factory, Fluent entity configurations, repository and unit-of-work implementations, and migrations defining the users, organizations, memberships, accounts, and verification token tables.

name: External Integrations
description: Infrastructure adapters for authentication concerns: JWT token issuance, BCrypt password hashing, Google ID token validation, Brevo email delivery, their typed settings, and the Infrastructure DI registration.

name: Configuration & Build
description: Solution and project files for the four Clean Architecture projects, appsettings and launch profiles for the API, and the environment variable template.

name: Deployment
description: Container packaging and orchestration: the multi-stage Dockerfile (build and runtime stages), docker-compose API service, and Docker ignore rules.

name: Documentation
description: Project specification and agent rules (AGENTS.md) plus the frontend integration guide describing how the Next.js client consumes the auth API.
